proc_p: Most storage jobs take four to six weeks to make once you approve the design.
steps: We measure the space, whether it’s under the stairs, an alcove or a utility, and ask what needs to live there.
You see the drawers, shelves and cupboards in 3D, with a quote that lists each one.
Everything is built to the exact size of the space in our workshop, so nothing is wasted.
We fit it so doors close flush and drawers run smoothly, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send us a photo of the space on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure it, ask what you need to store and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
